title: Entity history
responsibility: Shows changed commits with direct revision links, relative dates, source size, complexity and profile-scoped latency. Long reasons remain inline; no selected-change panel or duplicate action.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.entity
inputs.description: Required entity identity/name used for revision details and navigation. Caller is expected to recreate this view for a new entity or commit.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.rows
inputs.description: Required newest-first history through the shown commit, including known changes and unread candidates.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.index
inputs.description: Required index used to derive historical timings and profiles.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.scope
inputs.description: Required viewed commit used for labels and preferred initial selection.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.known
inputs.description: Required revisions already read, used to seed the detail map once at creation. Later prop replacements do not reseed it.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.client
inputs.description: Required revision reader. Failures are swallowed, leaving revision detail unknown rather than supplying false evidence.

inputs.name: EntityHistory.nav
inputs.description: Required context for links to this entity at historical commits.

outputs.name: EntityHistory
outputs.description: Shows changed commits with direct revision links, relative dates, source size, complexity and profile-scoped latency. Long reasons remain inline; no selected-change panel or duplicate action.
